```{r, include=FALSE}

library(RPostgres)
library(highcharter)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)



source("W:\\RDA Team\\R\\credentials_source.R")
con <- connect_to_db("eqb_hr1_tracker")

# set global options to ensure that comma separator is a comma for highchart graphs

lang <- getOption("highcharter.lang")
lang$thousandsSep <- ","
options(highcharter.lang = lang)

# preset variables for visualizing

before<-"June 2025"
after<-"October 2026"
```

# Data Findings

## Medi-Cal Indicators

### Medi-Cal Total Enrollment

```{r}

# Step 1: Read in relational table

df<-dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM dashboard.rel_medical_enrollment_county_jan27")

# Step 2: Create a visual 

df %>% 
   hchart(
    type = "bar", 
    hcaes(y = round(medical_enrollment_pct_change, 2), 
          x = county_name),

    color = "#2E8B57",
    negativeColor = "#C0392B",

    tooltip = list(
      pointFormat = "Total Enrollment 2025: {point.medical_enrollment_2025_06:,.0f}<br>
      Total Enrollment 2026: {point.medical_enrollment_2026_10:,.0f}"
    )
  ) %>% 
  hc_tooltip(crosshairs = TRUE) %>% 
  
  hc_xAxis( title = list(text = ""),
            labels=list(style=list(fontSize='15px'))) %>% 
  
  hc_yAxis( title = list(text = ""),
            labels = list(format = "{value}%")) %>%  ##this is for rate indicators only adding % signs 
  
  # title elements
  hc_title(
    text = paste0("Medi-Cal Total Enrollment"),
    align = "left", 
    style = list(useHTML = TRUE, fontWeight = "bold", fontSize='30px')
  ) %>%
    # subtitle elements
  hc_subtitle(
    text = paste0("Percent change in total enrollment from ",before," to ",after),
    align = "left", 
    style = list(useHTML = TRUE, fontWeight = "bold", fontSize='15px')
  ) 


# Step 3: Summary statistics

df %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(),
      list(
        min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        q25 = ~ quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75 = ~ quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        missing = ~ sum(is.na(.x))
      ),
      .names = "{.col}__{.fn}")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
    names_sep = "__") %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Summary Statistics",
    subtitle = "Distribution of indicators across counties") %>%
  cols_label(
    variable = "Indicator",
    min = "Min",
    q25 = "25th Pctl",
    median = "Median",
    mean = "Mean",
    q75 = "75th Pctl",
    max = "Max",
    sd = "SD",
    missing = "Missing") %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(min, q25, median, mean, q75, max, sd),
    decimals = 2) %>%
  opt_row_striping()

```
